notes.title: Version 1.1: New Modes - New Rare Items - New Achievements!
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.1[/b] When pressing start you now choose between "Normal", "Normal Marathon", "Hard" and " Hard Marathon". Hard changes various things to make this mode crazy hard while Marathon doubles the amount of objectives needed to complete a level. I've made some changes to make  normal easier, which is why I've added a hard mode(although hard mode is much harder than the old normal). I've also added new Super Items you  can only find in the danger zone and new achievements as well. Also Kellie remodeled the Sewer store! patch notes below!
[list]
[*] 10 new achievements.

[*] New Marathon Mode. Add this to hard or normal mode to double the objectives needed to beat a level. There's an achievement for finishing this 
mode in normal and hard.

[*] New Hard Mode. Various tweaks make this mode very difficult. Some changes are; Sewers lids aren't always around, enemies are sometime 
replaced with harder enemies, no skipping objectives to grind stats(except the Cemetery, good luck with that though), melee and ranged damage are  
doubled and other tweaks. There's a achievement for finishing this mode.

[*] Super Items. Super items are rare powerful items that you have a 40%(increased with the luck stat) chance to find in the Danger Zones. 

[*] New Super Item: Hammer. Infinite armor durability.

[*] New Super Item: Second Chance. When your health reaches 5 you destroy everything in the room and heal to full health and the item is destroyed. 

[*] New Super Item: All Stats Up. All stats are increased.

[*] New Super Item: Golden Crowbar. Gives you 10 crowbars.

[*] New Super Item: Gold Bar. Gives you 99 dollars.

[*] New Item: Wrench. Enemies now have a chance to drop Wrenches that repair your armor for one point.

[*] New Enemies. Three new variations of mini bosses have been added to the carnival for marathon mode.

[*] Kellie gave the sewer store an awesome upgrade.

[*] Change: Picking up health stat up items when the health stat is maxed will still heal you now. 

[*] Change: The amount of time you are Invincible after getting hit has been doubled.

[*] Change: Ranged damage you receive has been turned down in normal mode.

[*] Change: Santa's little helper now only attacks enemies near you instead of destroying everything on the map.

[*] Change: The super Macgyver costume now gives enemies a chance to drop ice cream.

[*] Change: Turned down the amount of cookies and milk the super Santa costume causes to drop.

[*] New Music Track.

[*] Added more tool tips on the street when starting.

[*] Fix: A Sphynx could get stuck in an unreachable spot in one of the Bottomless Pit Danger Zones keeping you from progressing.

[*] Fix: A Loot Goblin spawning in one of the Bottomless Pit Danger Zones kept you from progressing.

[*] Fix: There were a few wonky things going on with saves caused by the last patch.
[/list]

[EDIT]
Version 1.11: Small Fix

[b]Version 1.11[/b] Just a few changes and fixes after more 1.1 testing.
[list] 
[*] Change: I lowered the loot chance for various items in hard mode.
[*] Change: The sniper bullets from the danger zone now do only slightly more damage in hard mode as instead of double.
 [*] Fix: I had an achievement unlocking for the wrong accomplishment.
[*] Fix: There was a crash caused by becoming visible again when wearing the Invisible Man costume if there was a Loot Goblin in the room.
 [/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0: Creekside Creep Invasion is Released! Plus New Costumes!
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.0[/b] 
After two year in development Creekside Creep Invasion is out! We aren't done working on the game yet, we will continue to add content and fix any bugs you might run into. To celebrate the release of version 1.0 I added three new costumes for you to unlock, I'm not telling you what they are. Patch notes below, and thanks for your support!

[list]
[*] 3 New Costumes: I'll let you find out what they are.

[*] Change: The Invisible Man costume's passive is now poisoning enemies that touch you instead of random invisibility.

[*] Fix: I fixed a bug I introduced last patch that would crash the game if you opened a level up crate on the sewer lid. 
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 1.0: We Enter Beta With the Release of The Bottomless Pit!
notes.notes:
[b]Beta 1.0[/b] 
The final area is in! You can now play the game from beginning to end! The ending is very abrupt at the moment and other things won't make sense until the story boards are integrated, but it's playable! After you beat the game you have the option to start a new game plus. I will be adding more maps and polishing up the final area(including adding specific final battle music) over the coming weeks leading up to release. Patch notes below.

p.s. I apologize leaving the unavoidable Danger Zones in for multiple patches. I entered them every time I had a chance so I didn't realize they were impossible to avoid.

[list]
[*] The Bottomless Pit Area.

[*] 52 New Bottomless Pit Maps.

[*] 7 New Enemies.

[*] Final Boss Battle With Dr. Apollyon.

[*] 2 New Music Tracks.

[*] Fix: Fixed an issue causing Danger Zones to be unavoidable.

[*] Fix: Ai changes broke the Vampires last patch, they are fixed now.

[*] Fix: Fixed a crash caused by using Candy Corn ammo while wearing the Magician costume.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.55: Final Area Preview and Patch!
notes.notes:
[b]Alpha 1.55[/b]
We have a few screenshots of the final area "The Bottomless Pit" https://creeksidecreepinvasion.tumblr.com/post/162983097708/alpha-155-we-have-a-few-screenshots-of-the-final . This is where dr. Apollyon is getting all his demonic creeps from and where you will have your final confrontation with him! Kellie has now continued work on the story boards that we will be adding between all the levels so you can have a little context to your creep killing. The final area is still a little ways away but we are still on target for our mid-October full release! Patch notes below. More next week!

[list]
[*]New Armor Item: Sunny Side Up. Egg area effect is tripled.

[*]New Armor Item: More Merchant Stands. More hobo stands and Ice Gulp stands.

[*]New Armor Item: Double Stat Crates. Level up crates always contain a double stat item.

[*]New Armor Item: Shock Wave Crates. Level up crates create a shock wave when they land killing all enemies on the current map.

[*] 4 New Cemetery Maps

[*] 4 New Suburban Maps

[*] 8 New Carnival Maps

[*] You can now sell "Sell to Mechant" armor pieces at merchant stands(You could only sell them at the stores before).
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.50: The Carnival Update! Check out the video!

[b]Alpha 1.50[/b]

https://creeksidecreepinvasion.tumblr.com/post/161553881698/the-carnival-update-is

You will have to defeat Dr. Apollyon's three guards to try and stop him(but you won't stop him because there's one more area coming!). I also added a new unlockable costume, ammo type and new music! Kellie is hard at work on the final area, I'll post a preview of the assets sometime in the near future. Patch notes are below. More next week!

[*] 7 New Enemy Types(including three mini-bosses related to the objective).

[*] New Costume: Scientist. Activated Ability: Teleport.

[*] New Unlockable Ammo Type: Super Sprayer. High powered water gun!

[*] Five New Music Tracks.

[*] New Main Menu Music Track.

[*] Tons of new Carnival assets.
 
[*] And bunches of other stuff too boring to read.

[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 1.35 The Mercy Patch
notes.notes:
Iv'e added several changes to the game to make it slightly easier.

[b]Dash[/b] -- You can now dash with invincibility with spacebar  or left bumper.

[b]Zoom[/b] -- You can now zoom out with  left control or right bumper when outside. When zoomed out you can't move or shoot.

[b]Less enemies[/b] -- I've removed or rearranged the enemies on multiple maps in the downtown area.

[b]Other notes[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered controller aim sensitivity.

[*]New particle effects.

[*]Lowered range on silver bullets.

[*]Lowered range on ice cubes.

[*]Lowered range on crow eggs.

[*]Crows no longer blow up lamp posts or cars.

[*]Bananas are more slippery.

[*]Ice cubes slide.

[*]Moved some npc's to fix obscured text issue.

[*]Removed stat legend from options menu since you can view them in the "Tow To Play" menu item.
[/list]
Let me know if you run into problems. Have fun!
